package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/hybridapplication"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type HybridIntentService interface {
	CreateIntent(context.Context, string, string, hybridapplication.CreateIntentInput) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error)
	GetIntent(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.HybridLearningIntentReceipt, error)
}
type StudentHybridIntentHandler struct{ Intents HybridIntentService }

func (h *StudentHybridIntentHandler) CreateLearningIntent(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	actor, ok := hybridLearnerActor(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	path := chi.URLParam(r, "pathID")
	if !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(path) {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	var input hybridapplication.CreateIntentInput
	if err := decodeHybridIntentRequest(w, r, &input); err != nil {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	if h == nil || h.Intents == nil {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 503, "HYBRID_UNAVAILABLE")
		return
	}
	receipt, err := h.Intents.CreateIntent(r.Context(), actor, path, input)
	if err != nil {
		writeHybridIntentDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(receipt)
}
func (h *StudentHybridIntentHandler) GetLearningIntent(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	actor, ok := hybridLearnerActor(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	path, id := chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"), chi.URLParam(r, "intentID")
	if !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(path) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(id) {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	if h == nil || h.Intents == nil {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 503, "HYBRID_UNAVAILABLE")
		return
	}
	receipt, err := h.Intents.GetIntent(r.Context(), actor, path, id)
	if err != nil {
		writeHybridIntentDomainError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(receipt)
}
func hybridLearnerActor(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (string, bool) {
	id, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(id) {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 401, "HYBRID_FORBIDDEN")
		return "", false
	}
	if role != "STUDENT" && role != "STUDENT_PRO" {
		writeHybridIntentError(w, 403, "HYBRID_FORBIDDEN")
		return "", false
	}
	return id, true
}
func writeHybridIntentError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": code})
}
func writeHybridIntentDomainError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	status, code := 500, "HYBRID_UNAVAILABLE"
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridStale):
		status, code = 409, "HYBRID_STALE"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		status, code = 409, "HYBRID_CONFLICT"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridUnsupported):
		status, code = 422, "HYBRID_UNSUPPORTED"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		status, code = 422, "HYBRID_INVALID"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		status, code = 404, "HYBRID_NOT_FOUND"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden):
		status, code = 403, "HYBRID_FORBIDDEN"
	}
	writeHybridIntentError(w, status, code)
}
func decodeHybridIntentRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, out *hybridapplication.CreateIntentInput) error {
	typ, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || typ != "application/json" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes))
	if err != nil || !utf8.Valid(raw) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	if err = checkHybridIntentJSON(decoder, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = decoder.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if !hybridIntentRequiredShape(raw, reflect.TypeOf(*out)) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	decoder = json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(out) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func hybridIntentRequiredShape(raw json.RawMessage, typ reflect.Type) bool {
	if bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
		return false
	}
	for typ.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
		typ = typ.Elem()
	}
	switch typ.Kind() {
	case reflect.Struct:
		var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields) != nil {
			return false
		}
		for i := 0; i < typ.NumField(); i++ {
			f := typ.Field(i)
			parts := strings.Split(f.Tag.Get("json"), ",")
			if parts[0] == "-" {
				continue
			}
			key := parts[0]
			if key == "" {
				key = f.Name
			}
			value, present := fields[key]
			if !present {
				if len(parts) > 1 && parts[1] == "omitempty" {
					continue
				}
				return false
			}
			if !hybridIntentRequiredShape(value, f.Type) {
				return false
			}
		}
	case reflect.Slice:
		var values []json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &values) != nil || values == nil {
			return false
		}
		for _, value := range values {
			if !hybridIntentRequiredShape(value, typ.Elem()) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}
func checkHybridIntentJSON(d *json.Decoder, depth int) error {
	if depth > 8 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	token, err := d.Token()
	if err != nil || token == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	delim, compound := token.(json.Delim)
	if !compound {
		return nil
	}
	switch delim {
	case '{':
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for d.More() {
			token, err := d.Token()
			key, ok := token.(string)
			if err != nil || !ok || key != strings.ToLower(key) || seen[key] {
				return domain.ErrValidation
			}
			seen[key] = true
			if err = checkHybridIntentJSON(d, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		end, err := d.Token()
		if err != nil || end != json.Delim('}') {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	case '[':
		for d.More() {
			if err = checkHybridIntentJSON(d, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		end, err := d.Token()
		if err != nil || end != json.Delim(']') {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
